as_read: Pooled trials show small body-composition changes at about 3.2 g/day that authors doubt are clinically relevant; high-quality subgroups and several trials are null, so a human should rule, with no credit recommended.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; body mass, BMI, waist, fat mass, body fat percentage, fat-free mass
studies_to_add.quote: However, data from high-quality studies failed to show CLA's body fat-lowering properties.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; body weight, body composition, blood lipids
studies_to_add.quote: Compared with the control treatment, the CLA treatments did not affect changes in body weight, body composition, or blood lipids.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; VO2 max, time to exhaustion, anthropometrics
studies_to_add.quote: CLA had no effect on VO2 max (p = 0.5) also no change was seen in time to exhaustion (p = 0.51), weight (p = 0.7), BMI (p = 0.7) and WC (p = 0.8) vs PLA.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; total body fat by DXA
studies_to_add.quote: In conclusion, CLA supplementation was well tolerated and safe for the liver, which shows beneficial effects on fat composition in overweight and obese women.

stop_list: Clarinol, 4 labels: 227855 (Clarinol CLA Complex), 74772, 74776, 79239 (Clarinol CLA). Only named material trial read: Clarinol G-80 3.5 g/day, null (21593349).

Tonalin, 5 labels: 178574, 72871 (Tonalin CLA), 182799, 184586 (Tonalin Conjugated Linoleic Acid Complex), 218740 (Tonalin plus a Conjugated Linoleic Acid row). No abstract read names Tonalin as the tested material; 42112190 is a safety statement.
Multi-ingredient labels, including 74477, 213499, 27243 (6 rows), 213309, 74428 (16 rows), 1059 (7 rows), 213313, 74397 (5 rows), 58697 (3 rows), 69551 (6 rows): reviewed studies tested CLA alone.
Isomer ratio isn't printed on the labels read, so the fit to a 50:50 mix is not shown for any label.
clinician_items: 42112190: EFSA panel statement says safety of Clarinol and Tonalin TG 80 was established for the proposed uses and doses for up to six months, not established beyond six months, and not established in type-2 diabetic subjects.
36270407: pooled RCTs found no ALT or AST change.
32560516: 3 g/day, abstract reports liver safety on 13C-methacetin breath test and enzymes.
21990002: adverse events included constipation, diarrhea and soft stools.
36048508: adverse-event risk ratio 1.32 (95% CI 0.94-1.84) with exercise.
stored_rating_note: Stored positive_weak on 21990002 reflects the pooled numbers; its abstract closes by saying the evidence does not convincingly show clinically relevant effects. The stored material_form includes purified trans-10,cis-12; no label read prints a purified isomer.
unread_notes: Abstracts only. 2 searches used (108 and 33 hits), newest first and capped at 30 and 15. Other listed hits, including 41169023, 39439191, 38567248, 37794481, 36911696, 37763810, 35704027, 27586548, 26402730, 25034667, 24796987 and the CLA-plus-omega-3 trials, were not opened and are not cited. 37671495's abstract was read to 2300 characters; its last sentence was cut, and the quoted sentence is complete. 28071044 and 32560516 both report 74 women on 3 g/day for 12 weeks; abstracts don't say whether these are one trial, and the results differ on the outcomes each reports.
